# Magic UI Backlight

Source: https://magicui.design/r/backlight.json

Docs and examples: https://magicui.design/docs/components/backlight

Upstream implementation inspected November 9, 2026 through the Magic UI registry connector. The TypeScript props type was removed for this JavaScript project; React is explicitly imported for the existing JSX build. The SVG Gaussian blur, saturation and SourceGraphic composition are unchanged. No dependencies beyond React are required.
